home.heroTitle: Stay close to everything in Cebu.
home.heroLede: Clean rooms, easy parking, and a simple way to book your stay.
home.introTitle: A quiet stay with a Japanese spirit
home.introLede: Welcome to Mori International Hotel — where traditional Japanese calm meets contemporary comfort.
home.introP1: Our property features a pioneering modular design with 19 cozy rooms of about 18 square meters, each with inverter air conditioning, 24-hour hot and cold showers, complimentary drinking water, unlimited Wi-Fi, and ample parking.
home.introP2: Just 6 kilometers from the airport and 4 kilometers from Cebu City’s major seaports, you are close to restaurants, shops, and everyday conveniences — without losing the sense of rest.
home.introNote: Book ahead and your room is held as a reservation. Arriving within the minimum lead time? It stays a standard booking.
home.galleryCopy: Buildings, Hallways, Lounge, and Reception — tap a frame to browse that album.
home.browseRoomTypes: Browse our room types — open a room to see availability and book.
home.contactCta: Always busy? No time for calls? You wish to book a room in the soonest possible time and make sure the room will be ready for you by the time you arrive? We recommend that you use our online booking with best available prices!
home.locationBody: The hotel's convenient location, approximately 700 meters from SM Jmall and just a mere four-minute drive from Oakridge Business Park, makes it an ideal choice for business travelers and tourists alike. Its close proximity to these key destinations allows for easy access to shopping, dining, and commercial activities in the area.

rooms.heroLede: Clean, quiet rooms for rest after a day in Cebu — browse availability and book in a few steps.
rooms.introCopy: Air conditioning, hot showers, drinking water, and Wi‑Fi in every room — so your stay feels simple from the first night.

details.termsIntro: Our top priority is ensuring your comfort and satisfaction throughout your stay with us. From the moment you walk through our doors, you will experience exceptional hospitality and personalized service designed to cater to your every need. Thank you for choosing us as your home away from home – we look forward to exceeding all of your expectations during your stay at our hotel.
